title: Undergraduate Thesis Reproducibility Archive: Differentiable Logic Gate Networks
description: A retrospective preservation and reproducibility archive for Matheus Kunzler Maldaner's 2025 University of Florida undergraduate thesis. The archive inventories thesis-era notebooks and experimental artifacts recovered from HiPerGator and provides deterministic checks for the quantitative results that can be reconstructed from the preserved evidence. It was assembled after the thesis was accepted and the degree was awarded.
